notes: Workflows look cinematic: stouter cards with bigger names that stay readable zoomed out, soft glowing connectors, hand-drawn icons for every role and a crest of its own for each agent you forge. Teams with Codex now finish their steps reliably, agents never miss their first instruction, re-running a workflow can't stall, loops are always found and drawn correctly, and saved workflows can't be overwritten by a failed load. The Agent Forge reads your files more cleanly, writes better exams without repeats, and shows mastery from its exams.
